brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit (small footprint base arrangement with work surface)
requirements.evidence: 3 full bases at 0,0,0 0,1,0 1,0,0 forming compact triangle (~499x335 mm), topped with 3 full covers; capped and joint-bolted. Covers provide continuous deck f13.
notch:0#-1,1#notch0 stem hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf placed in empty cell -1,1 between the two adjacent bases at 0,0,0 and 0,1,0 - provides pull-out drawer frame.

requirements.requirement: Spike at a corner where three bases meet
requirements.evidence: spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 mount spike at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 - the shared corner of the three bases.
setSpikeAccessory platform-sm on same spike; check_build ok and meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Compact 3-base triangular desk with full covers, a notch drawer frame at -1,1, and a mount spike with small platform at the central 3-way junction. Build verified: check_build ok, meshClash clear, capped and locked.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
